metadata.citation: Agfa, Professional Films, F-PF-E4, fourth edition, August 2004, page 8; Agfachrome RSX II 100; Jan Lohse spectral_film_lut Status A table; Colour Science.
metadata.datasource: https://analoguephotolab.com/wp-content/uploads/2019/04/AGFA-Films.pdf; PDF SHA256 1a80cea6b7afca268ace723f969a5027197c8c6118483372000b98a63b35298e; source SHA256 6b53d0905bfae764e11c00279067d0b2f43c989f17a7b8f276ff447052fe943d. Agfachrome RSX II 100; daylight 1/100 second; AP44/E-6; Status A/M densitometry. Rebuild scripts/prepare_agfa100.py; see docs/agfachrome100.md. Publication drawing, not batch-specific measurements. CMY density curves are treated as additive basis spectra; base removal is inferred from the common clear-end segment. No independently measured clear-film spectrum or nonneutral layer coupling. Spectrograph uses 2850 K tungsten; the printed lg Sensitivity axis is explicit but no equal-energy conversion was applied by Agfa. Characteristic curves are printed at daylight 1/100 s, AP44/E-6, Status A; exact batch and scanner response unknown. RMS 10 is a 48 µm/diffuse-density-1.0 measurement, not a runtime grain calibration. Neutral clear-end prior plus residual dye minima is inferred, not a measured base spectrum. Status A uses legacy response tables, 1 nm log-linear interpolation and Simpson projection to the 5 nm transmission grid, not certified ISO 5-3 weights. Monotone dye amounts regularize small publication drawing reversals; no extrapolated exposure latitude. Sensitivity log-slope and dye linear tails are assumptions outside plotted support; outward growth is prevented. Each aggregate CMY record is a numerical effective dye amount, not a measured emulsion sublayer. Nonneutral exposure coupling and the fourth Agfa layer are not identified by the available one-dimensional plots. D55 is an implementation daylight convention; RGB midgray exposure normalization is not absolute ISO calibration. Input-adapter training and holdout measure spectral reconstruction, not matched physical film or scanner fidelity. No calibrated stock-specific grain, halation, DIR or MTF; builtin preset must leave unmeasured effects off or explicitly approximate. The 2850 K wedge spectrogram is printed as lg Sensitivity but no equal-energy conversion or source spectrum is supplied.
